commit_message: Expose ADR0127 Sprite Animation to Project Rust
pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR0127 Native 2D first release
pr_body:
## Summary

Continues ADR0127 first-release completion on the existing Draft PR. Extends the existing Project Rust Animation command family with deferred SpriteAnimator2D play/pause/stop and stable-AssetId clip selection, adds a copied deterministic Sprite Animation state view, and documents the stable-ID boundary. The implementation reuses current ABI v3 command/view architecture rather than introducing a parallel gameplay API.
